errors.invalid_form: The form was incomplete. Reload the page and try again.

inbox.title: Action inbox
inbox.subtitle: Proposals from the success engine. Nothing changes until a person approves, edits or dismisses them.
inbox.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open cards} one {# open card} other {# open cards}}
inbox.empty: No open cards. You're all caught up.
inbox.topFactors: Top factors (score points · against the grade cohort)
inbox.noEvidence: No risk evidence is attached to this card.
inbox.readOnly: Only a {role} or an admin can decide this card.

risk.title: Risk explanation
risk.subtitle: How the score is built: every factor's contribution, compared with the student's grade cohort.
risk.totalHint: Contributions add up exactly to the score.
risk.explainer: Each factor's risk (0–100) is multiplied by its weight; factors without data are left out and the remaining weights are rescaled. “Against cohort” shows the points above (+) or below (−) a typical student in the same grade.
risk.empty: No risk score yet. It appears after the first recompute with grades or attendance.

profile.noOpenCards: No open action cards for this student.

trackHistory.title: Track history
trackHistory.subtitle: Every track assignment, newest first. A track only changes when a person approves a card.
trackHistory.empty: No track assignments yet — the student is on the default Growth track.
